title: sorghum × nitens
intro: Sorghum × nitens, commonly known as broom corn, is a hybrid plant species derived from the cross between Sorghum bicolor and Sorghum arundinaceum. It is rich in nutrients and has been associated with several health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of broom corn include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The extracts and compounds derived from broom corn have been studied for their potential in traditional medicine, particularly in treating cardiovascular diseases and oxidative stress-related conditions.
